【证据支持】The saved plan for Finch Q24 estimates 1200 rows to examine.
The saved EXPLAIN plan states explain_rows=1200, which represents the optimizer's estimate of row examinations. [chunk:e73fba3b55621da36fd27f30]

【证据支持】The plan contains an estimate of rows to be examined.
EXPLAIN's rows field is defined as the optimizer's anticipated row examination count; the plan records explain_rows=1200. [chunk:e73fba3b55621da36fd27f30] [chunk:79c6cbf5fe6104a198660c83]

【证据支持】The latency exports contradict a consistent p95 latency for the same window.
Export A reports p95=80 ms and Export B reports p95=120 ms for the same 10:00-10:01 UTC window and 1000 requests, indicating inconsistency. [chunk:0ea70064f0418a1e516d1f14] [chunk:b9fd5c0f2d268ccd532c9233]

【证据不足】Exactly 1200 rows were actually examined during execution.
The saved plan provides only an estimate; no actual row counter or runtime observation confirms the exact number of rows examined. [chunk:e73fba3b55621da36fd27f30]

【存在矛盾】The exports establish one consistent p95 latency for the same window.
Export A reports p95=80 ms and Export B reports p95=120 ms for identical conditions, directly contradicting consistency. [chunk:0ea70064f0418a1e516d1f14] [chunk:b9fd5c0f2d268ccd532c9233]

【证据不足】An index change is confirmed as the cause of the latency difference.
No index-change history or causal evidence is provided; the exports lack execution details to confirm causation.

citations.title: MySQL EXPLAIN rows estimate and runtime observation
citations.text: Adapted MySQL 8.4 manual note: EXPLAIN's rows field represents the optimizer's anticipated row examination count.
